critical_abuse_cases.threat: Compromised CI publishes and deploys its own artifact
Old valid release is replayed after a vulnerability fix
Canary appears healthy but corrupts data
controls: automatic rollback forbidden for data changes

critical_abuse_cases.threat: Metrics outage is interpreted as successful deployment
Automatic rollback repeats irreversible external effects
controls: traffic rollback separate from data rollback

critical_abuse_cases.threat: Registry or transparency outage prevents emergency verification
One operator signs, deploys, promotes, and conceals evidence
